```sql
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_items.ordered_at) AS month,
    SUM(order_items.product_price) AS revenue
  FROM dev.order_items AS order_items
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_items.ordered_at)
)
SELECT
  month,
  (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS revenue_growth_mom
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 500
```
